title: Bluest vs. other checking accounts
summary: This document explains that Bluest checking accounts earn 2.25% APY on your balance and highlights how that APY can outperform typical standard transactional checking accounts. It notes the value of a higher APY when maintaining substantial balances to offset opportunity cost of keeping funds available for payments/transfers.
